नेशनल अवॉर्ड जीतने के बाद भी इस स्टार एक्ट्रेस की आर्थिक स्थिति हो गई थी खराब! 😲

कीर्ति सुरेश ने News18 को दिए एक इंटरव्यू में खुलासा किया कि 2018 में फिल्म Mahanati के लिए बेस्ट एक्ट्रेस का नेशनल अवॉर्ड जीतने के बावजूद उन्हें लगातार छह महीने तक कोई नया प्रोजेक्ट नहीं मिला।

एक्ट्रेस ने बताया कि शुरुआत में लगातार काम के बाद ब्रेक पाकर वह खुश थीं, लेकिन जल्द ही उन्हें अहसास हुआ कि नए प्रोजेक्ट न मिलने से उनकी फाइनेंशियल स्टेबिलिटी बिगड़ रही है।

कीर्ति ने इस खाली वक्त में वर्कआउट शुरू किया और अपना बॉडी ट्रांसफॉर्मेशन किया। उन्होंने बताया कि Mahanati के बाद मेकर्स समझ ही नहीं पा रहे थे कि उन्हें किस तरह के रोल ऑफर किए जाएं।

फिलहाल कीर्ति अपनी आने वाली सीरीज Akka के प्रमोशन में बिजी हैं, जिसमें उनके साथ Radhika Apte भी हैं। यह सीरीज 30 October को Netflix पर रिलीज होने जा रही है। 🔥

क्या आपको भी लगता है कि एक बहुत बड़ी हिट के बाद एक्टर्स को नए रोल मिलने में दिक्कत आती है? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय दीजिए! 👇

ctx.title: Keerthy Suresh says ‘financial stability went for a toss’ during career lull even after Mahanati's success
ctx.summary: Keerthy Suresh said filmmakers struggled to decide what roles to offer her after Mahanati changed how the industry viewed her.
ctx.text:
Keerthy Suresh is currently busy promoting her upcoming film Akka , co-starring Radhika Apte . In a recent interaction, the actor spoke about the career lull she faced after Mahanati (2018), the biopic on late actor Savitri. Although she won the National Film Award for Best Actress for her performance in the film, she did not receive any new projects for six months after its release.
Speaking to News18, Keerthy recalled that she did not view the break as something unpleasant but was happy to have some time off after shooting back-to-back films. However, she soon realised that her financial stability was taking a hit as new projects stopped coming her way.
“First of all, I needed a break at that time because I was working back-to-back. In a way, I was happy until I realised that my financial stability was going for a toss. But in those six months, I started doing nicer things.”
Keerthy, who has previously spoken about being body-shamed, shared that she also used the break to get into shape.
“I used the time to transform myself and take care of my body. From 2013 to 2018, I only used to shoot, eat, sleep and repeat. There was nothing called workout in my life. I was like, ‘Mera face toh kaam kar raha hai (My face is working), why do I’ve to worry about my body?’ But that wasn’t the right perspective. I was a little plump and I wanted to get healthy – not because I wanted to look a certain way. In those six months, I started working out for the first time. That’s when I had a makeover.”
The actor added that she does not regret taking those six months off, as the experience helped her focus on herself and taught her how to manage her finances better.
Keerthy also spoke about how filmmakers struggled to figure out what roles to offer her after Mahanati. Before the biopic, she had largely played girl-next-door characters, and the success of the film changed how she was perceived in the industry. She said the film eventually opened doors to more substantial roles.
Set in the 1980s in Pernuru, a fictional South Indian city ruled by female gangsters, Akka follows a powerful sisterhood whose control is threatened by the arrival of a mysterious outsider. The series stars Keerthy Suresh and Radhika Apte in the lead roles and is directed by Dharmaraj Shetty. It is scheduled to premiere on Netflix on October 30.
